Name: Miel Vibrance ReShade Preset
Author: lilianap
Description:
[center][font=Courier New][i][img]https://i.postimg.cc/L86BCdG4/icon.png[/img]﻿

Miel Vibrance is is a shader preset created for Stardew Valley with [url=https://reshade.me/]ReShade[/url]﻿ 5.4.7
[/i][/font][/center]
[font=Courier New][b][u]
[/u][i] ﻿// How to install ReShade [/i]


[/b][list=1]
[*]- Go to the [url=https://reshade.me/]ReShade[/url]﻿ website and click the download button.
[*]- Run the file it gives you and click browse. Go to your Stardew valley folder (The one with Stardew Valley.exe in it)
[*]- Choose EITHER Stardew Valley.exe if you want to play vanilla OR StardewModdingAPI.exe if you want to use ReShade with mods.
[*]- Choose OpenGL. If you chose the wrong one, restart from step 2.
[*]- Finish the installation as usual.
[*]- Run Stardew Valley as usual. Make sure you run the .exe you installed ReShade onto, be it the vanilla game or the ModdingAPI.
[*]- You should see a grey bar up at the top. Press the Home button to do
the tutorial, and you're set! You've successfully installed ReShade.
[/list][i]
[b] ﻿[/b][/i][b][i]// How to install [/i][/b][i][b]Miel Vibrance[/b][/i]

[list=1]
[*]- Open up your Stardew folder. (The one where you installed ReShade)
[*]- Copy 'miel.vibrance.ini' and 'reshade-shaders'
[*]- Paste the two files into your Stardew folder. (if it asks if you want to merge, say yes. [b]don't replace![/b])
[*]- Done! You should be able to access the preset in Stardew Valley now.
[/list][/font]
